basic_profile.bio: Living in the heart of Oxford, I've been an avid cyclist for over a decade. When not on two wheels, I'm working as a software developer specializing in embedded systems. I'm an Oxford University alum with a passion for sustainable technology and green commuting. I enjoy discussing tech trends, especially in the open-source domain. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings or during my lunch breaks. Currently single, I'm always on the lookout for fellow tech enthusiasts or cycling buddies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in computer engineering from Oxford University, my expertise lies in embedded systems and PCB design. I have honed my skills through both formal education and practical experience, working for a tech startup in the city. Additionally, I'm self-taught in cycling mechanics, having rebuilt bikes from scratch.
